```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 13,
  fig.height = 7
)

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(knitr)
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
# ── Universe & data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("project_tree")) source(here("project_tree.R"))
if (!exists("etf_metadata")) source(here(project_tree$scripts$init))

raw_data       <- read_rds(here(project_tree$products$raw_p_d))
tech_summary   <- read_rds(here(project_tree$products$tech_summary))
outlier_report <- read_rds(here(project_tree$products$ref_report))

today     <- Sys.Date()
ytd_start <- as.Date(paste0(year(today), "-01-01"))
mtd_start <- floor_date(today, "month")
w52_start <- today - 365

perf_data <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  summarise(
    latest_price = last(adjusted),
    latest_date  = last(date),
    price_ytd    = first(adjusted[date >= ytd_start]),
    price_mtd    = first(adjusted[date >= mtd_start]),
    low_52w      = min(adjusted[date >= w52_start], na.rm = TRUE),
    high_52w     = max(adjusted[date >= w52_start], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ytd_ret   = (latest_price / price_ytd) - 1,
    mtd_ret   = (latest_price / price_mtd) - 1,
    range_pct = pmin(pmax((latest_price - low_52w) / (high_52w - low_52w), 0), 1)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    etf_metadata %>% select(ticker, name, asset_class, pf_function, tree_level, sub_block),
    by = c("symbol" = "ticker")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tech_summary %>% select(ticker, trend_regime, momentum_status, ma200),
    by = c("symbol" = "ticker")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    outlier_report %>% select(ticker, label),
    by = c("symbol" = "ticker")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ytd_ret), pf_function != "Signal")

regime_colors <- c(
  "Bullish"            = "#2D6A4F",
  "Bullish-Correction" = "#F77F00",
  "Bearish-Relief"     = "#E07B39",
  "Bearish"            = "#D90429"
)
```

---

## 1. Market Snapshot

```{r snapshot-table}
spy     <- perf_data %>% filter(symbol == "SPY")
n_bull  <- sum(perf_data$trend_regime == "Bullish",  na.rm = TRUE)
n_bear  <- sum(perf_data$trend_regime == "Bearish",  na.rm = TRUE)
n_bcorr <- sum(perf_data$trend_regime == "Bullish-Correction", na.rm = TRUE)
n_brel  <- sum(perf_data$trend_regime == "Bearish-Relief",     na.rm = TRUE)
n_total <- nrow(perf_data)

tibble(
  Metric = c("SPY YTD", "SPY MTD", "SPY 52W Position",
             "Bullish", "Bullish-Correction", "Bearish-Relief", "Bearish",
             "Universe (ex-Signal)"),
  Value  = c(
    percent(spy$ytd_ret,   accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus"),
    percent(spy$mtd_ret,   accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus"),
    percent(spy$range_pct, accuracy = 1),
    paste0(n_bull,  " / ", n_total),
    paste0(n_bcorr, " / ", n_total),
    paste0(n_brel,  " / ", n_total),
    paste0(n_bear,  " / ", n_total),
    as.character(n_total)
  )
) %>%
  kable(align = c("l", "r"))
```

---

## 2. 52-Week Range by Asset Class

Each bar shows where the ETF's current price sits within its 52-week high/low range.
Colour = trend regime. Right label = YTD return.

```{r range-plot, fig.height=9}
plot_data <- perf_data %>%
  mutate(
    ytd_label    = percent(ytd_ret, accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus"),
    ticker_label = paste0(symbol, "  ", str_trunc(name, 20))
  ) %>%
  arrange(asset_class, range_pct)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = reorder(ticker_label, range_pct))) +

  # track
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 1, yend = ticker_label),
               color = "grey85", linewidth = 2.5, lineend = "round") +

  # filled bar
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = range_pct, yend = ticker_label,
                   color = trend_regime),
               linewidth = 2.5, lineend = "round") +

  # current position dot
  geom_point(aes(x = range_pct, color = trend_regime), size = 3) +

  # YTD label
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.02, label = ytd_label,
                color = ifelse(ytd_ret >= 0, "#2D6A4F", "#D90429")),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.7, fontface = "bold") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.13),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = c("52W Low", "25%", "50%", "75%", "52W High")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = regime_colors, na.value = "grey60") +

  facet_wrap(~ asset_class, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +

  labs(
    title    = paste("52-Week Range Position —", format(today, "%d %b %Y")),
    subtitle = "Bar = current position within 52W range  |  Right label = YTD return  |  Colour = trend regime",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Regime"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7.5, lineheight = 1.3),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 9),
    plot.margin        = margin(12, 16, 12, 12)
  )
```

---

## 3. YTD Return by Asset Class

```{r ytd-plot, fig.height=8}
perf_data %>%
  mutate(
    ticker_label = paste0(symbol, "  ", str_trunc(name, 22)),
    bar_color    = ifelse(ytd_ret >= 0, "#2D6A4F", "#D90429")
  ) %>%
  arrange(asset_class, ytd_ret) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ytd_ret, y = reorder(ticker_label, ytd_ret), fill = ytd_ret >= 0)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +

  geom_text(aes(label = percent(ytd_ret, accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus"),
                hjust = ifelse(ytd_ret >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
            size = 2.5, color = "grey30") +

  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2D6A4F", "FALSE" = "#D90429")) +

  facet_wrap(~ asset_class, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +

  labs(
    title    = paste("YTD Returns —", format(today, "%d %b %Y")),
    subtitle = "Sorted ascending within each asset class",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7.5, lineheight = 1.3),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 9),
    plot.margin        = margin(12, 16, 12, 12)
  )
```

## 4. Regime Breadth

```{r breadth-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
perf_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(trend_regime)) %>%
  count(asset_class, trend_regime) %>%
  mutate(trend_regime = factor(trend_regime,
    levels = c("Bullish", "Bullish-Correction", "Bearish-Relief", "Bearish"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(asset_class, n), fill = trend_regime)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = regime_colors, na.value = "grey70",
                    drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = "Regime Breadth by Asset Class",
    subtitle = "Count of ETFs in each trend regime",
    x = "Number of ETFs", y = NULL, fill = "Regime"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "right",
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 9)
  )
```

## 5. Full Performance Table

Searchable and sortable. Sorted by YTD return descending.

```{r perf-table}
tbl_data <- perf_data %>%
  arrange(desc(ytd_ret)) %>%
  transmute(
    Ticker        = symbol,
    Name          = name,
    `Asset Class` = asset_class,
    Function      = pf_function,
    Price         = latest_price,
    YTD           = ytd_ret,
    MTD           = mtd_ret,
    `52W Low`     = low_52w,
    `52W High`    = high_52w,
    `52W Pos`     = range_pct,
    Regime        = trend_regime,
    Sigma         = label
  )

reactable(
  tbl_data,
  searchable      = TRUE,
  sortable        = TRUE,
  highlight       = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 60,
  columns = list(

    Ticker = colDef(
      width = 70,
      style = list(fontWeight = "bold")
    ),

    Name = colDef(width = 210, style = list(fontSize = "12px")),

    `Asset Class` = colDef(width = 110, style = list(fontSize = "12px")),
    Function      = colDef(width = 120, style = list(fontSize = "12px")),

    Price = colDef(
      width  = 75,
      format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 2)
    ),

    YTD = colDef(
      width  = 80,
      name   = "YTD %",
      format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 1),
      style  = function(value) {
        list(color      = if (value >= 0) "#2D6A4F" else "#D90429",
             fontWeight = "bold")
      }
    ),

    MTD = colDef(
      width  = 80,
      name   = "MTD %",
      format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 1),
      style  = function(value) {
        list(color      = if (value >= 0) "#2D6A4F" else "#D90429",
             fontWeight = "bold")
      }
    ),

    `52W Low`  = colDef(width = 75, format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 2),
                        style = list(fontSize = "12px")),
    `52W High` = colDef(width = 75, format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 2),
                        style = list(fontSize = "12px")),

    `52W Pos` = colDef(
      name  = "52W Range",
      width = 140,
      cell  = function(value) {
        pct   <- round(value * 100)
        color <- if (value >= 0.7) "#2D6A4F" else if (value <= 0.3) "#D90429" else "#457B9D"
        htmltools::div(
          style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;",
          htmltools::div(
            style = "flex:1; background:#e9ecef; border-radius:3px; height:10px;",
            htmltools::div(style = paste0(
              "background:", color, "; width:", pct, "%; height:10px; border-radius:3px;"
            ))
          ),
          htmltools::span(style = "font-size:11px; color:#888; min-width:30px;",
                          paste0(pct, "%"))
        )
      }
    ),

    Regime = colDef(
      width = 150,
      style = function(value) {
        color <- switch(value %||% "",
          "Bullish"            = "#2D6A4F",
          "Bearish"            = "#D90429",
          "Bullish-Correction" = "#F77F00",
          "Bearish-Relief"     = "#E07B39",
          "grey50"
        )
        list(color = color, fontWeight = "600", fontSize = "12px")
      }
    ),

    Sigma = colDef(
      width = 130,
      style = function(value) {
        list(color    = if (grepl("EXHAUSTION", value %||% "")) "#F77F00" else "grey60",
             fontSize = "11px")
      }
    )
  )
)
```
